note: hand review (rulings 3, 14): the corpus has "This otherwise works like the standard bombs class feature"; print (Inner Sea Magic p. 33) says "This ability otherwise functions as and replaces the standard alchemist bomb class feature". Print's wording is taken; it states the one trade, bombs.

hand review (ruling 41, structural): the box Black Blood of Orv (Inner Sea Magic p. 33) is set beside the Crypt Breaker, but the rules it gives are the ones the Black-Blooded Oracle uses ("See the sidebar on the facing page for rules on the black blood itself", p. 32); it is an unlisted section of that entry (edits file) and not part of this one.

hand review (rulings 3, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 34) opens "At 14th level, a crypt breaker's alkahest grows more potent." and ends "This ability replaces persistent mutagen"; the corpus has the effect only. Print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 3, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 37) adds the key "An asterisk (*) indicates a discovery detailed in Ultimate Magic"; the asterisks that mark those discoveries stay with their key (ruling 10 drops only asterisks without a printed key).

hand review (rulings 3, 8, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 32) folds the five printed levels into one paragraph and says the 17th-level modifier applies to "Diplomacy and Intimidate" where the corpus has "Bluff and Intimidate"; print's wording is taken as printed.
hand review (rulings 14, 16): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 32) keeps the cross-reference "(see below)" and the sentence "The diva must spend an additional round ..."; wording only.

hand review (rulings 8, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 35) says "By spending a move action focusing on his whirling", "once per day at 8th level and one additional time per day for every two dervish levels he has beyond 8th" (the corpus's usage row "1 time/day + 1 per 2 dervish levels beyond 8th" says the same) and "the dirge of doom bardic performance"; print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 8, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 36) is one paragraph, "At 4th level and 8th level, the Mendevian priest gains a bonus feat ... The cleric must meet the prerequisites of the selected bonus feat"; the corpus's 8th-level row says the same in other words. Print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 3, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 37) names the subdomains "from the Advanced Player's Guide, if available in the campaign" and ends "In all other respects, this works like and replaces the standard cleric's domain ability"; the corpus lacks both. Print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 3, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 41) says the swift action lasts "for a number of rounds per day equal to her inquisitor level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive"; the corpus's usage row "1 time/day per inquisitor level" is the import's misreading. Print's wording is taken.

hand review (ruling 15): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 32) lists the revelations that all black-blooded oracles "have access to" under Black Blood Revelations; a revelation is a choice from that list, so it is a plain subheading of the feature and no class feature of its own. Print's wording (1 point per 2 oracle levels; 1/2 her oracle level times per day) equals the corpus's rows.

hand review (ruling 15): a revelation of the Black Blood Revelations list (Inner Sea Magic p. 32), a plain subheading of that feature. Print says "At 7th level, she can use this ability twice per day. At 15th level, she can use the ability 3 times per day"; the corpus has no progression. Print's wording is taken.
hand review (ruling 15): a revelation of the Black Blood Revelations list (Inner Sea Magic p. 33), a plain subheading of that feature.

hand review (rulings 8, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 37) says the favored enemy bonus increases "by +2 at 5th, 10th, 15th, and 20th level"; the corpus's rows give +4, +6, +8, +10, the same values from +2. Print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 8, 9, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 37) says the favored terrain bonus increases "by +2 at 8th, 13th, and 18th level"; the corpus's rows give +4, +6, +8, the same values from +2. Its last sentence repeats the Focused Enemy sentence ("replaces the standard favored enemy ability") where the ability it replaces is favored terrain, written so (misprint, recorded in the review note and scripts/errata.tsv). Print's wording is otherwise taken.
hand review (rulings 3, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 37) names "Table 3-12: Ranger in the Core Rulebook"; the corpus says "the ranger's spell table". Print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 3, 14, 16): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 38) gives the class skills Knowledge (religion) and Perform and the loss of Appraise and Fly, and keeps the cross-reference "(see page 10)"; the corpus lacks the class skills. Print's wording is taken.
hand review (rulings 8, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 38) says "replaces the bloodline spells gained at 3rd level and 5th level respectively"; wording only.

hand review (rulings 9, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 40) says "Inscribe Magic Tattoo"; the feat is Inscribe Magical Tattoo (the book's own feat list, and the corpus link), so it is written so (misprint, ruling 9). Print's wording is otherwise taken.

hand review (rulings 3, 14): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 35) is one paragraph with the usage "a number of times per day equal to 3 + his Charisma modifier" and ends "This ability otherwise replaces the summon monster ability of a normal summoner"; the corpus words the same facts as rows. Print's wording is taken.

hand review (rulings 9, 14, 43): print (Inner Sea Magic p. 39) says "a primalist uses his shadow" in the Shadowcaster's first ability, a repeat of the Primalist's wording before it; the intended name is certain, so it is written "a shadowcaster" (misprint, recorded in the review note and scripts/errata.tsv).
